blocks.text: Keep your home fresh and spotless with Melaleuca Tough & Tender 12x All-Purpose Cleaner. This super-concentrated formula is tough on dirt and grime yet gentle on surfaces, making it ideal for cleaning counters, tables, appliances, and even natural stone. Unlike conventional cleaners, it contains no caustic chemicals, ensuring a safer and more natural clean without harsh fumes or residues. Made with biodegradable, plant-derived ingredients, Tough & Tender effectively cuts through grease and messes while being environmentally responsible. Plus, one small 8 fl. oz. bottle makes up to 6 full spray bottles of cleaner, giving you long-lasting value and superior cleaning power. Perfect for daily use, it provides streak-free results and leaves your home fresh and clean—without exposure to chlorine, ammonia, or other harsh chemicals. Directions: Add concentrate to the “12x” line in a spray bottle. Fill the bottle with water to the “Fill” line. Spray on surfaces and wipe clean—no rinsing required. Caution: Eye irritant. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If irritation occurs, rinse thoroughly with water and seek medical advice if necessary. Do not mix with bleach.

items: Powerful 12x Concentrated Formula – A little goes a long way! This super-concentrated cleaner removes everyday dirt, grease, and grime with ease.
Safe & Gentle on Surfaces – Effectively cleans counters, tables, appliances, and even natural stone—without using caustic chemicals.
Plant-Derived & Biodegradable Ingredients – Made with naturally derived cleaning agents, Tough & Tender delivers powerful cleaning while being eco-friendly.
No Harsh Fumes or Residues – Free from ammonia, chlorine, and other harsh chemicals, making it safer for your home and family.
Cost-Effective & Easy to Use – One 8 fl. oz. bottle makes up to 6 full spray bottles of cleaner (Mixing Spray Bottle not included).
